**Risk call: refuse. Do not buy at any size.**

The brief shows a launch dominated by one operator: 1,402 SOL bought in the first two minutes with a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.0001, top-5 buyers holding 99.96%, and a launch bot present. That is a classic bundle, and the "OPERATOR" class has no edge for us. The 30-minute return of +30,718% and a $14.8M market cap are a dump setup, not a signal. Holding 30-115 minutes into an insider-controlled float with thin real sell-side liquidity means we would be the exit liquidity.

Any size fails. If the desk insisted, the minimum $5 ticket with a 20% stop would still sit inside a pool where a single wallet can exit faster than our order fills. We skip.
memos.scout:
The strongest honest case for buying HOOKED is thin, and the data mostly argues against it.

The one signal in its favor is the last 15 minutes: 43 buyers and 9.51 SOL of buy volume against 7.53 SOL sold, net inflow of about 2 SOL, price up 0.26%. Real demand does show up as buyers arriving after the launch spike, and that's the only sign of organic activity here.

Everything else cuts the other way. The first two minutes after graduation show 1,402 SOL from 15 buyers with a launch bot present, and the top five buyers hold 99.96% of that flow. The curve data shows bundled supply. This is the operator pattern, which has been roughly break-even at best, and the 307x return over 30 minutes is the kind of move that comes from concentrated, not broad, buying. The sell-to-buy ratio in the launch window is near zero, so the operator's supply was never sold into the market, which means it is still overhanging.

I don't see a case that this demand will hold over the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: insider distribution, and the operator-backed label may be hiding it. The first two minutes after graduation show 1,402 SOL bought from just 15 outside buyers, with top-5 buyer share at 99.96% and sell-to-buy ratio at 0.0001. That is near-total concentration, and the bundle share of 1.0 on the curve means the same few wallets controlled the entry. Price is up 307x in 30 minutes, but the last 15 minutes show 7.53 SOL sold against 9.51 bought, with 26 sellers, so exits are already starting. The 0.04% drawdown from the 30-minute high is not evidence of strength; it just means no one has sold a meaningful size yet. A $20 ticket at 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost can't survive a sudden dump from a holder group this concentrated. Skip.
